scripts.dev: dotenvx run -- env HUGO_MODULE_WORKSPACE=go.work $(hvm status --printExecPathCached) server --port=1313 --disableFastRender
scripts.dev:kill: pids=($(lsof -t -sTCP:LISTEN -iTCP:1313 2>/dev/null | sort -u)); if (( ${#pids[@]} )); then echo "Found PIDs: ${pids[*]}"; echo "Sending SIGTERM..."; kill -- "${pids[@]}"; sleep 3; remaining_pids=(); for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then remaining_pids+=($pid); fi; done; if (( ${#remaining_pids[@]} )); then echo "Sending SIGKILL to remaining PIDs: ${remaining_pids[*]}"; kill -9 -- "${remaining_pids[@]}"; echo "Done."; else echo "All processes terminated gracefully."; fi; else echo "No processes found on port 1313."; fi
scripts.dev:restart: pnpm run dev:kill; pnpm run dev
scripts.rebuild:workspace: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:workspace
